audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Gwen Level 2 and calls Levels 4-5 and Level 6 even, while whys[1] says his pull-into-isolated-Q out-stats a toolless level 2, whys[3] says he wins the pre-6 extended fight, and whys[4] plus the spike say 6 is the flip to Gwen.
audit.why: Gwen wins this lane at 59.62% but only from 6 onward; before Hallowed Mist exists she is a melee with no untargetability against a shielded bruiser.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Mordekaiser / Gwen / Mordekaiser / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Death's Grasp and Realm of Death are the two abilities the whole page tells you to dodge and bait, with no cooldown on either.
audit.why: Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8s — sixteen seconds at rank 1, an enormous punish window early and only eight seconds by rank 5, which is why the lane gets harder to kite as he levels it. Realm of Death is 140/120/100s and Indestructible 12s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the whys, spike, mid and cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says to 'grind his max-HP through Indestructible' and to 'out-sustain' it, as if the shield were just a health bar to chew. Riot's text: Indestructible 'stores damage he deals AND TAKES to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.'
audit.why: Your %-max-HP damage is what builds the shield, and he can cash the whole thing back as healing — so a long grind with no Grievous Wounds actively funds him. Anti-heal has to be on him before he consumes it, not after.
audit.corrected: Stated in wants.you[1], the R-window spike, Key Ability Interactions and the cooldown breakdown.

edits.before: His E pull into an isolated Q slam plus the Indestructible shield out-stats your toolless level 2 — farm at range, do not contest the trade.
edits.after: Death's Grasp (E, 16s at rank 1) into an isolated Obliterate plus the Indestructible shield out-stats your toolless level 2 — farm at range.

edits.before: Pre-6 you are a melee with no mist and no untargetability against his shielded trades — he wins the extended fight, so dodge the E pull and farm.
edits.after: Pre-6 you are a melee with no mist against his shielded trades, and every hit you land feeds Indestructible — dodge the 16-second pull and farm.

edits.before: Needlework slows him out of walk-up range and Hallowed Mist's armor/MR lets you survive Realm of Death and out-sustain Indestructible in the 1v1.
edits.after: Needlework slows him out of walk-up range and Hallowed Mist's armour/MR carries you through Realm of Death — with Grievous on before he cashes the shield.

edits.before: Grind his stacked HP and Indestructible shield with Snip Snip! (Q) %-max-HP plus the true-damage center snip, healing back everything via Thousand Cuts
edits.after: Have Grievous Wounds on him BEFORE he consumes Indestructible — the shield is built from damage he deals and takes, and he can turn all of it into a heal

edits.before: Pop Indestructible (W) to win an extended trade and bank the absorbed damage as a heal
edits.after: Let you feed Indestructible (W, 12s) with your own damage, then consume the shield as a heal

edits.before: Realm of Death is his only real win condition into you — bait and dodge his E pull first, then save W to drop fresh armor/MR inside the realm so his Q + Indestructible cannot out-stat your %-HP grind.
edits.after: Realm of Death (140s at rank 1) is his only real win condition — dodge the 16-second E pull first, then drop fresh mist inside the realm and make sure Grievous is on him before he cashes Indestructible.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still rough — you are a melee with no untargetability and no W yet against his shield-backed trades, so keep farming and side-stepping the E pull instead of forcing. Everything flips at 6: Needlework (R) slows him so he cannot walk you down, Hallowed Mist gives you armor/MR (and hides you from a Morde standing outside it), and Thousand Cuts heals you through Indestructible. The key play in Realm of Death is to hold W — when he ults you into the box, drop fresh mist for the stats and keep snipping his max-HP through the stat steal; your %-HP grind out-trades a Morde forced to commit his whole kit just to kill you.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still rough — a melee with no untargetability against shield-backed trades — so farm and side-step Death's Grasp (16s at rank 1) instead of forcing. Everything flips at 6: Needlework slows him out of walk-up range, Hallowed Mist gives you armour and MR and hides you from a Morde standing outside it, and Thousand Cuts heals you back. In Realm of Death, hold W and drop fresh mist as the box forms. One warning: Indestructible is built from damage he deals AND takes, so a blind grind funds it — land Grievous before he consumes it. Keep snipping his max-HP through the stat steal — your %-HP grind out-trades a Morde who has to spend his whole kit just to kill you.

edits.before: Track Mordekaiser's Realm of Death: His 1v1 realm — W won’t escape it. Out-DPS it. When it is down — Snip him in the realm.
edits.after: Indestructible (W, 12s) is built from damage he deals AND takes, and he can cash it as a heal — Grievous first, then grind.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His 1v1 realm — W won’t escape it. Out-DPS it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Realm of Death (R): 140/120/100s — W will not escape the box, so out-DPS it. - Death's Grasp (E): 16s at rank 1 falling to 8s — the pull gets harder to dodge as he ranks it. - Indestructible (W, 12s): your damage feeds it and he can heal off it.

notes: The kit file gives Obliterate a derived 'grounding' flag, but Riot's description says only that it smashes the ground for damage, increased against a single target. Per the trust-the-description rule I did not claim it stops Skip 'n Slash — worth a human check, because if it does ground, it changes every escape line on this page.
